title: Care:FULL "Protective Factors Against Violence in Home-Based Care: A Quantitative Cross-Sectional Study Based on the Ecological Model"
summary: Many people in need of care in Germany are looked after at home by their relatives. This important task can be associated with considerable strain. In some cases, it may even lead to conflictual or violent situations. Our study aims to find out how often such situations occur, what burdens caregiving relatives face, and – most importantly – what factors can strengthen and protect them. The goal is to gain a better understanding of caregiving relatives in order to provide more targeted support.
conditions: Prevalence of violence in home care
